record.paper_title: Some open problems in computational algebraic geometry
record.original_question: Over the complex numbers, for each genus g <= 10 and each finite group G that occurs as the full automorphism group of genus-g algebraic curves, determine all inclusion relations among the loci M(g,G) in the moduli space M_g, where M(g,G) denotes the locus of genus-g curves whose automorphism group is G.

evidence.quote: M(g, H) (locus of curves in Mg with automorphism group H) is a sublocus of M(g, G).
Problem 4. Determine the inclusion among the loci M(g, G) for algebraic curves defined over C and genus g <= 10.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Work over the field of complex numbers. For a positive integer g ≥ 2, let M_g denote the coarse moduli space of smooth projective algebraic curves of genus g. For a finite group G, define M(g, G) ⊆ M_g to be the locus of (isomorphism classes of) genus-g curves C whose full automorphism group Aut(C) is isomorphic to G. For each integer g with 2 ≤ g ≤ 10, and for every finite group G that arises as the full automorphism group of some smooth projective complex curve of genus g, determine all inclusion relations among the loci M(g, G); equivalently, decide for every ordered pair (G, H) of such groups whether M(g, H) ⊆ \overline{M(g, G)} inside M_g, and thereby describe the complete poset of containments among these automorphism-stratification loci for each g ≤ 10.
artifact.category_tag: Automorphism loci of curves in moduli spaces
artifact.status_search_result: Inclusions among automorphism-group loci in M_g have been determined completely for low genera (notably g = 3, with explicit equations) and partially for genera up to 10 in cases where the automorphism group G is "large", using Hurwitz/Breuer classification of group actions on curves of genus ≤ 48. A complete determination of all inclusion relations for every group G arising in every genus g ≤ 10 does not appear to have been fully achieved in the literature.

status_evidence.title: The locus of curves with prescribed automorphism group
status_evidence.snippet: M(g, G, C) denotes the locus of genus g curves admitting a G-action; classification given completely for g = 3, and for g ≤ 10 for 'large' G.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist: full classification for g=3 and for large groups up to g=10.

status_evidence.title: Albanian J. Math., automorphism loci
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses inclusions between loci of curves with prescribed automorphism groups in low genus.
status_evidence.claim: Inclusion problem is an active area of study but not completely resolved for all g ≤ 10.
